rules: 1D candles (NY 18:00 roll); 1h CISD = phase-3 rung 0 (series_open, 2/2, max_wait 3)

per (daily candle, direction), walk every 1h closure: 'yes' at the closure where a CISD whose extreme bar is inside the candle confirms the candle's running extreme as a protected swing; 'no' at every other closure while no confirmed extreme holds; after a 'yes', closures are skipped until the running extreme exceeds that protected swing (then back to 'no')
rows = the 'yes' closures only (stop = protected swing); attempt = 1 + earlier 'yes' answers in the same candle and direction whose protected swing was later exceeded
gate allowed = attempt <= 2 (first + 'one more'); complement = attempt >= 3 (past the last chance)
decide at the 1h close; enter next M1 open; 2R; hold 10h

params_source.htf: corpus: RX8vtP3PLYk 'Do I think that this is the wick of the daily candle' (asked on hourly closures)
params_source.ltf: corpus: RX8vtP3PLYk 'even here just on the hourly, I could look to take an entry'
params_source.per_closure: corpus: RX8vtP3PLYk 'After each closure, I'm going to ask myself, do I think that this wick has formed?'
params_source.yes_rule: corpus: RX8vtP3PLYk 'I'm going to wait for an intra-candle change in the state of delivery'; wick-confirming = protected swing == HTF running extreme (structure_own_02b readings a/b construct)
params_source.cisd: phase3: meta/conjunction_preregistration.md §1.8-1.16 (locked rung-0 CISD: series_open, 2/2, max_wait 3, stop = protected swing, 2R, 10 entry-TF bars)
params_source.stop_yes: corpus: RX8vtP3PLYk 'put my stop on that wick because if the wick is formed, that stop shouldn't get taken out'
params_source.stop_no: corpus: RX8vtP3PLYk 'Would I trust taking any sort of entry in here and putting my stop right on this current wick'
params_source.rr: corpus: RX8vtP3PLYk 'And I can look for two R.'
params_source.max_hold: phase3: meta/conjunction_preregistration.md §1.8-1.16 (locked rung-0 CISD: series_open, 2/2, max_wait 3, stop = protected swing, 2R, 10 entry-TF bars)
params_source.direction: declared-before-run: both directions, no bias input (phase-3 bias rung refuted; not part of the new claim)
params_source.last_closure: declared-before-run: no rows at the HTF candle's final LTF closure (entry would fall in the next candle)
params_source.allow_attempts: corpus: RX8vtP3PLYk 'generally want to see one more high, and this would be kind of our last chance before I give up on the idea'; declared-before-run: attempt = a confirmed wick, a new attempt only after the previous one was exceeded; allowed = first + one more (<= 2)
